scenario: A cardiology relay lane should close only after the referral ticket, previous referral note, provider message, requirement note, case note, and referral coordinator note still point to the same fresh referral lane.
user_instruction: Please finish the cardiology relay for case MED-1636. Start from referral ticket RFC-1636, rebuild the supporting trail it cites, and only take the approved close step if the relay still lines up.

medical_referral_case_tickets.body_text: Referral ticket RFC-1636: rebuild the cardiology relay by checking previous referral note PRN-1636, provider message PM-1636, requirement note RQN-1636, case note CN-1636, and coordinator note AGN-1636. If no active cardiology referral remains and the relay still aligns, the approved close step is to submit a fresh cardiology referral.

medical_previous_referral_notes.body_text: Previous referral note PRN-1636: the earlier cardiology routing item expired after intake drift and should reopen only through a fresh referral.

medical_provider_messages.body_text: Provider message PM-1636: once the relay is rebuilt and there is no active cardiology referral left, reopen the lane through a fresh cardiology referral.

medical_referral_requirement_notes.body_text: Requirement note RQN-1636: if MED-1636 has no active cardiology referral left, the approved close step is to submit a new cardiology referral.

medical_case_notes.body_text: Case note CN-1636: the relay still closes through the fresh cardiology referral lane once every supporting carrier lines up.

medical_referral_agent_notes.body_text: Coordinator note AGN-1636: do not reopen booking directly from this hold; clear it through a fresh cardiology referral once the relay is rebuilt.
